name: Selma Fortenmayer
original_name: セルマ・フォルテンマイヤー
source:
She is one of the dragoniths who lack the power of transformation, who are commonly called "rakka". Despondent, she sees the world obliquely, but a little lonely. She had always believed that rakka did not qualify as a successor, but when she inherited Divine Crest, proving herself to be a "Descendant One," she was devastated.

[Translated from [url=https://dlsoft.dmm.co.jp/detail/will_0114/]DMMStore[/url]]
